facts.statement: The fossil remains of Arenysuchus were discovered in the Tremp Formation at Arén, Huesca, Spain, by researchers José Manuel Gasca and Ainara Badiola.
facts.quote: It was found by the researchers José Manuel Gasca and Ainara Badiola from the Tremp Formation, in Arén of Huesca, Spain.

facts.statement: Arenysuchus was first named and described by Eduardo Puértolas, José I. Canudo, and Penélope Cruzado-Caballero in 2011.
facts.quote: It was first named by Eduardo Puértolas, José I. Canudo and Penélope Cruzado-Caballero in 2011

facts.statement: Arenysuchus is an extinct genus of crocodylomorph that lived during the late Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous in northern Spain.
facts.quote: Arenysuchus (meaning "Arén crocodile") is an extinct monospecific genus of allodaposuchid eusuchian crocodylomorph from Late Cretaceous (late Maastrichtian stage) deposits of north Spain.

facts.statement: The genus is known from a partial skull (holotype MPZ ELI-1) and four teeth found at the Blasi 2 site.
facts.quote: It is known from the holotype MPZ ELI-1, a partial skull from Elías site, and from the referred material MPZ2010/948, MPZ2010/949, MPZ2010/950 and MPZ2010/951, four teeth from Blasi 2 site.

facts.statement: Arenysuchus shares a feature with early crocodilians where the frontal bones contact the margins of the supratemporal fenestrae.
facts.quote: One feature linking it to early crocodilians is the contact of the frontal bones with the margin of the supratemporal fenestrae, two holes in the top of the skull.

facts.statement: The frontal bone of Arenysuchus is unusual because its front end is extremely long.
facts.quote: The frontal bone is also unusual in that its front end is extremely long.

facts.statement: Near the frontal bone, the lacrimal bones of Arenysuchus are unusually wide compared to their length.
facts.quote: Near the frontal, the lacrimal bones are unusually wide in comparison to their length.

facts.statement: The infratemporal bar of Arenysuchus is very thin and vertically expanded, unlike the thicker, laterally expanded bars of most other crocodilians.
facts.quote: The infratemporal bar (a projection of the jugal bone below the infratemporal fenestra) is very thin and vertically expanded.

facts.statement: Arenysuchus can be distinguished by an infratemporal bar that is tabular, vertically oriented, and has extreme lateromedial compression.
facts.quote: Arenysuchus can be distinguished by the following features: an infratemporal bar that is tabular and vertically oriented, with little dorsoventral thickness and an extreme lateromedial compression

facts.statement: In its original 2011 analysis, Arenysuchus was classified as one of the most basal members of the superfamily Crocodyloidea.
facts.quote: In Puértolas, Canudo & Cruzado-Caballero's original 2011 phylogenetic analysis, Arenysuchus was found to be one of the most basal members of Crocodyloidea, the superfamily of crocodilians that includes crocodiles and their extinct relatives

facts.statement: Subsequent phylogenetic studies have debated the classification of Arenysuchus, finding it to be the sister taxon of Allodaposuchus and a member of Allodaposuchidae.
facts.quote: Alternatively, subsequent phylogenetic studies have found Arenysuchus to be the sister taxon of Allodaposuchus and a member of Allodaposuchidae

facts.statement: During the late Maastrichtian, Europe existed as an island archipelago surrounded by shallow seas.
facts.quote: During the late Maastrichtian, Europe was an island archipelago surrounded by shallow seas.

facts.statement: The Tremp Formation, where Arenysuchus fossils were found, dates to the late Cretaceous and has been dated using planktonic foraminifers and magnetostratigraphy.
facts.quote: The Tremp Formation dates to the late Cretaceous. It has been dated by means of planktonic foraminifers and magnetostratigraphy.

facts.statement: The Elias site, where the holotype was found, dates from approximately 67.6 to 65.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: The bottom of the Elias site is about 67 million years old, so the site dates from 67.6 to 65.5 Ma.

facts.statement: Arenysuchus is classified within the family Allodaposuchidae.
facts.quote: familia: Allodaposuchidae

facts.statement: The generic name Arenysuchus refers to the place of its discovery combined with the Greek term 'suchus', which translates to crocodile.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se refiere al lugar de su hallazgo junto al término "suchus", de griego que traduce cocodrilo.

facts.statement: The specific epithet of Arenysuchus honors the researchers who discovered the holotype.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie homenajea a los investigadores que descubrieron el holotipo.

facts.statement: The genus is known from a partial skull and four teeth.
facts.quote: Arenysuchus es conocido de un cráneo parcial y cuatro dientes.

facts.statement: A primitive crocodilian trait is the contact between the frontal bone and the margin of the supratemporal fenestra.
facts.quote: Una característica que lo vincula a los crocodilianos primitivos es el contacto del hueso frontal con el margen de la fenestra supratemporal, dos agujeros en lo alto del cráneo.

facts.statement: The frontal bone is unusual because its anterior end is extremely long.
facts.quote: El hueso frontal también es inusual ya que su extremo delantero es extremadamente largo.

facts.statement: A sharp projection of the frontal bone divides the nasal bones, which make up most of the midline snout length.
facts.quote: Una aguda proyección del frontal divide los huesos nasales, que componen la mayor parte de la longitud de la línea media del hocico.

facts.statement: Near the frontal bone, the lacrimal bones are unusually wide compared to their length.
facts.quote: Cerca del frontal, los huesos lacrimales son inusualmente amplios en comparación a su longitud.

facts.statement: The infratemporal bar, a projection of the jugal bone below the infratemporal fenestra, is very thin and expanded vertically.
facts.quote: La barra infratemporal, una proyección del hueso yugal bajo la fenestra infratemporal, es muy delgada y expandida verticalmente.

facts.statement: A distinguishing feature from other basal crocodyloids is its small palatal process, a bony lamina of the maxilla forming the front part of the palate.
facts.quote: Otra característica de Arenysuchus que lo distingue de otros crocodiloides basales es su pequeño proceso palatal, una lámina ósea del maxilar que forma la porción delantera del paladar.

facts.statement: It possessed a fossa between the seventh and eighth maxillary teeth, a feature previously seen only in "Crocodylus" affinis.
facts.quote: Arenysuchus también tenía una fosa entre el séptimo y el octavo diente maxilar que solo había sido visto en "Crocodylus" affinis.

facts.statement: All other lower jaw teeth were fixed inward toward the upper jaw teeth, so they were covered by the upper teeth when the jaws were closed.
facts.quote: Todos los otros dientes de la mandíbula inferior estaban fijados hacia el interior de los de la mandíbula superior, por lo que estaban cubiertos por los dientes superiores, cuando las mandíbulas estaban cerradas.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Arenysuchus as one of the most basal members of Crocodyloidea, the superfamily including modern crocodiles and their extinct relatives.
facts.quote: En el análisis filogenético de Puértolas, Canudo & Cruzado-Caballero, Arenysuchus es situado como uno de los más basales miembros de Crocodyloidea, la superfamilia de crocodilianos que incluye a los cocodrilos modernos y a sus parientes extintos.

facts.statement: Along with Prodiplocynodon, it is known from the Late Cretaceous, making them the oldest known crocodyloids.
facts.quote: De estos géneros, solo Arenysuchus y Prodiplocynodon son conocidos del Cretácico Superior, lo que los hace los crocodiloides más antiguos conocidos.

facts.statement: Its parent group is Allodaposuchidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Allodaposuchidae

facts.statement: It belongs to the family Allodaposuchidae.
facts.quote: Family: Allodaposuchidae

facts.statement: It lived during the Maastrichtian stage, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: It was part of an initial evolutionary radiation of crocodilians in the Northern Hemisphere during the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Arenysuchus fue parte de una radiación evolutiva inicial de crocodilianos en el Hemisferio Norte durante el Cretácico Tardío.

facts.statement: By the end of the Maastrichtian, Europe consisted of a series of island archipelagos surrounded by shallow seas.
facts.quote: A fines del Maastrichtiense, Europa era una serie de archipiélagos de islas rodeadas por mares poco profundos.

facts.statement: Crocodilians were completely absent from Europe before this time.
facts.quote: Los crocodilianos estaban completamente ausentes de Europa antes de esta época.

facts.statement: The Tremp Formation, where fossils were found, dates to the Late Cretaceous and has been dated using planktonic foraminifera and magnetostratigraphy.
facts.quote: La Formación Tremp data de finales del Cretácico. Ha sido datada a través de foraminíferos planctónicos y la magnetoestratigrafía.

facts.statement: The lower zone of the Elias site is about 67 million years old, dating the site from 67.6 to 65.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: La zona inferior del sitio Elias tiene cerca de 67 millones de años, por lo que el sitio data de 67.6 a 65.5 millones de años.

facts.statement: Dinosaurs were abundant, including a diversity of sauropods, theropods, and ornithopods.
facts.quote: Los dinosaurios eran abundantes, con una diversidad de saurópodos, terópodos y ornitópodos.

facts.statement: With the formation of the archipelago, a faunal change occurred in the Late Maastrichtian, where dinosaurs became rarer, represented mainly by hadrosaurs.
facts.quote: Con la formación del archipiélago, hubo un cambio faunístico en el Maastrichtiano tardío. Los dinosaurios se volvieron más raros, representados sobre todo por los hadrosaurios.

facts.statement: Crocodilians became a major component of the island ecosystems.
facts.quote: Los crocodilianos se volvieron un componente mayor de los ecosistemas isleños.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the fossa between the seventh and eighth maxillary teeth held a dentary bone tooth if the lower jaw was present.
facts.quote: Esta fosa pudo haber sostenido a un diente del hueso dentario si la mandíbula inferior estaba presente.
